# Poshkaar Kashmir

Poshkaar Kashmir presents a curated catalogue of textiles, clothing, gifts and objects.

Core topics:

- Kashmiri embroidery
- Pashmina shawls
- Sozni embroidery
- Tilla work
- Aari embroidery
- Bridal Kashmiri couture
- Handcrafted Indian luxury fashion

Brand summary:

Each published product record is intended to state its own verified material, origin, care, availability and fulfilment information.
